versions.content: If development error reporting is enabled via IdsMDevEr- rorDetect , the IdsM module shall call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT when any API other than IdsM_Init or IdsM_GetVer- sionInfo is called in uninitialized state.

If development error reporting is enabled via IdsMDevEr- rorDetect , the IdsM module shall call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT when any API other than IdsM_Init or IdsM_GetVer- sionInfo is called in uninitialized state.

If development error reporting is enabled via IdsMDevEr- rorDetect , the IdsM module shall call Det_ReportError with the error code IDSM_E_PARAM_UNINIT when any API other than IdsM_Init or IdsM_GetVer- sionInfo is called in uninitialized state.
